minor.issue: In this preview env the ingress adds the shared GCP load-balancer IP 34.111.104.211 as the rightmost X-Forwarded-For entry, and no CF-Connecting-IP header reaches the backend. So every client that does not send True-Client-IP gets the same IP. My spoof test (5 bad admin logins) put an IP lock on 34.111.104.211, which then blocked the real admin login in the browser with 429 until I deleted my rows. On Render with Cloudflare this is fine. But if those headers are ever missing (direct *.onrender.com access or a misconfigured proxy), the admin IP lock becomes a global DoS, and an attacker who reaches the origin directly can forge True-Client-IP to get past the IP limit (the per-login limit still holds). Suggestion: only trust True-Client-IP/CF-Connecting-IP when the request comes from a Cloudflare IP range, or log a warning when they are missing.

slowapi '5/minute' per IP is checked before the guard's per-IP limit of 20, so a different email from the same IP within the same minute gets 429 (from slowapi), not 401. After about 60s, other emails get 401 as specified. This is expected layering; the test now waits 62s.
Disabling needs password + TOTP only; a backup code is not accepted. If the admin loses the phone, they cannot disable 2FA from the UI (they can still log in with a backup code).
Opening the UI setup leaves totp_pending_enc in admin_account until the next setup. Harmless.

critical_code_review_comments: login_guard.clear_failures clears only per-login rows, so IP-scoped failures from other logins stay until the 15-min window passes. This is intended.
Admin per-IP limit (5) equals the per-login limit (5): one NAT/office IP with several wrong attempts locks every admin login from that IP. This is acceptable for a single admin account.
TOTP replay protection covers only the last code within 90s. Fine with valid_window=1.
routers/admin.py is about 1038 lines; consider splitting out the auth/2fa routes.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use True-Client-IP with random IPs for brute-force tests. Without it, all clients share the LB IP 34.111.104.211 and you can lock out the real admin.
